name: For each is kept when a fired ability has no closing period
notes: "Activate only …" takes the last full stop with it and the boost lost its count (+1/+1). Graverobber Spider: two creature cards in your graveyard, 4/6. Sunbathing Rootwalla: three basic land types, 5/5. Captain Jonathan Archer: Human, Officer, Spider, Lizard, Goblin, Scout are six creature types among your non-Borg creatures, the opponent's Elf Druid not counted, so Goblin Guide is 8/8.

scryfallData.name: Elvish Mystic
scryfallData.flavor_text:
"The Three Rings of the Elves were not made as weapons of war or conquest—that is not their power. Those who made them did not desire strength or domination or hoarded wealth, but understanding, making, and healing, to preserve all things unstained."
—Elrond

scryfallData.name: Graverobber Spider
scryfallData.oracle_text:
Reach
{3}{B}: This creature gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of creature cards in your graveyard. Activate only once each turn.
scryfallData.flavor_text: Cloaks woven from its webs are durable and waterproof but said to bring on nightmares.

scryfallData.name: Sunbathing Rootwalla
scryfallData.oracle_text: Domain — {3}{G}: Until end of turn, this creature gets +1/+1 for each basic land type among lands you control. Activate only once each turn.
scryfallData.flavor_text: A rootwalla's prey includes anything or anyone that wanders into view.

scryfallData.name: Captain Jonathan Archer
scryfallData.oracle_text:
When Captain Archer enters, create Porthos, a legendary 1/1 green Dog creature token.
Federation — {G}, {T}: Target creature you control gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the number of creature types among non-Borg creatures you control. Activate only as a sorcery.

scryfallData.name: Goblin Guide
scryfallData.oracle_text:
Haste
Whenever this creature attacks, defending player reveals the top card of their library. If it's a land card, that player puts it into their hand.
scryfallData.flavor_text: "I've been all over this world. I even remember some of those places."

scryfallData.name: Forest
scryfallData.flavor_text:
"You have only one mission, minions: protect me with your lives. In order to do this, you need to wear down Captain Britain's psyche. In order to do *that*, you need to burn down her precious lands. Am I understood?"
—Morgan Le Fay

scryfallData.name: Island
scryfallData.flavor_text:
"The Dream Dimension. A benevolent fountain of ideals, the source of humanity's collective inspiration, and the home of the muses themselves. Its wonder never ceases to amaze me."
—Doctor Strange

scryfallData.name: Plains
scryfallData.flavor_text:
"Asgard is my home, my kingdom, and my pride. Its splendor, like the gods, shall be everlasting."
—Thor
